description: This file defines the StockAnalytics class for stock data visualization and reporting in the ERPNext system, extending the StockGridReport class. It includes methods for setting up filters, columns, preparing data, and displaying stock ledger details.

classes.name: StockAnalytics
classes.description: Class for stock analytics report, extending erpnext.StockGridReport, with methods for data setup, filtering, and display.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the StockAnalytics object with configuration for filters, columns, and report setup.

methods.name: setup_columns
methods.description: Defines and sets up the columns for the report table.

methods.name: setup_filters
methods.description: Configures filters for the report, including refresh triggers and zero-value display.

methods.name: init_filter_values
methods.description: Initializes default filter values, such as setting the range to 'Monthly'.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the stock data for display, including tree structure and balance calculations.

methods.name: prepare_balances
methods.description: Calculates opening, closing balances, and stock movements within the date range.

methods.name: update_groups
methods.description: Aggregates data for parent groups based on child items.

methods.name: show_stock_ledger
methods.description: Navigates to the stock ledger report for a specific item.
